head_coach.name: Sabri Lamouchi
head_coach.play_style_summary: Focuses on a high press, fast vertical transitions, and structured defensive solidity. Lamouchi prefers a compact central midfield that is hard-working and quick to win back possession, utilizing rapid transitions to play direct balls to wide players.

key_players.name: Hannibal Mejbri
key_players.performance_stats: For Burnley in the 2025/2026 season, he made 27 appearances (1,231 minutes played), maintaining a 77.3% pass completion rate, creating 21 chances, winning 102 duels, and making 29 tackles with a high-energy pressing style.

key_players.name: Montassar Talbi
key_players.performance_stats: For FC Lorient in the 2025/2026 season, he played 29 matches (2,610 minutes) with an 89.2% pass completion rate, won 77 aerial duels (62.1% success), made 186 clearances, 22 tackles, and 26 interceptions.

key_players.name: Elias Achouri
key_players.performance_stats: For FC Copenhagen in the 2025/2026 season (1,303 minutes), he achieved an 82.8% pass completion rate, created 26 chances, completed 24 successful dribbles (42.1% success), won 76 duels, and made 19 tackles.
